provenance.extraction: Full recorded getTokenDailyPrice payloads; values are not resampled or interpolated.

price.query: query getTokenDailyPrice($id: String!, $fromTime: Int!) { token(id: $id) { snapshots: dailyTokenSnapshot( first: 1000 where: { timestamp_gte: $fromTime } ) { timestamp priceUSD basketRate } } }

supplyAndStakedRSR.query: query getTokenDailyPrice($id: String!) { rtoken(id: $id) { snapshots: dailySnapshots( first: 365 orderBy: timestamp orderDirection: desc ) { timestamp rsrStaked } } token(id: $id) { snapshots: dailyTokenSnapshot( first: 365 orderBy: timestamp orderDirection: desc ) { timestamp supply: dailyTotalSupply } } }

rsrPrice.method: Existing PriceUpdater Chainlink latestRoundData answer formatted with 8 decimals
